name: Publish as draft
description: Turns the selected blog submissions into DRAFT posts signed by The Anon and marks them accepted. Add the hero image, tags and excerpt, then publish the post as usual. Preview a draft at /blog/<slug>?draft=1. Managed in the repo: deploy/directus/flows/publish-submission.json.
